title: IAM users enumeration
description: Enumerates IAM user names in the account; IAM is global, the region only routes the call.

params.name: region
params.description: Routing region; IAM is a global service

template: SELECT user_name, region FROM aws.iam.users_list_only WHERE region = '{{region}}';
notes: For per-user detail (ARN, creation date, path) read aws.iam.users with data__Identifier set to the user name, one request per user. Related list-only resources in the same service cover roles (aws.iam.roles_list_only) and groups (aws.iam.groups_list_only) with the same shape.
